_note: Shape of <work>/analysis/<date>.json. The entries below are invented examples: replace them. Evidence is paraphrased, never quoted; no names, ids, links or emails anywhere (rsi.sh analysis-check enforces this). Every task whose packet names where it went wrong needs a went_wrong line. status: proposed, approved or skipped (rsi.sh decide), merged, rejected or superseded.

failure_modes.title: A pasted link is searched for instead of opened
evidence: Asked what a pasted page is about: the trace shows two general searches and no call to the tool for that system, then a request to paste the text.
The Tool Choice judge line failed on both tasks; Correctness failed on one.

went_wrong.what: Step 2 was a second general search; the tool that opens the linked page was never called.

failure_modes.cause: The instructions never say that a link names its own system, so general search is the first reflex.

not_failures.why: The task's system has no simulator, so the honest 'cannot reach it' reply is the right one.

proposals.title: Open a pasted link with the tool for that system
proposals.after: When the user gives you a link, open it with the tool for that system before anything else. Use general search only if that tool fails, and say that it failed.
proposals.expected: Tool Choice and Correctness on knowledge-question tasks that carry a link.
